claims.claim: Meta reported Q2 2026 revenue of $60.80B, up 28% year over year, with ad impressions up 14% and average price per ad up 12%.

factors.name: core monetization scale
factors.basis: Both ad volume and pricing grew double digits while revenue rose 28%.

risks.risk: Q2 costs and expenses rose 55% year over year and capex was $31.08B, making AI infrastructure intensity a material execution burden.

unknowns.unknown: Scout does not infer return on incremental AI capex from one quarter of operating data.

claims.claim: Meta generated $31.86B operating cash flow in Q2 but only $784M free cash flow as capex accelerated; cash and marketable securities were $90.26B and long-term debt $83.66B.

factors.name: AI investment conversion
factors.basis: Strong revenue/advertising execution is paired with unusually high capital intensity, so future returns on infrastructure are a key expectation test.

risks.risk: Legal charges, severance and rapid infrastructure spending can obscure normalized cost conversion and raise disappointment risk if AI monetization lags.

unknowns.unknown: No canonical valuation or entry-price conclusion is asserted by Scout.
